name: Klipper Status Display
author: Dennis Guse
description: Shows the state of a Klipper 3D printer (via Moonraker) as light: idle, preheating, print progress, pause, error, finished.

hint.de: IP-Adresse oder Name des Druckers, zum Beispiel 192.168.1.50
hint.en: IP address or name of the printer, for example 192.168.1.50

hint.de: Nur nötig, wenn dieses HyperLED nicht zu den trusted_clients in der moonraker.conf gehört
hint.en: Only needed if this HyperLED is not one of the trusted_clients in moonraker.conf
hint.ru: Нужен, только если этого HyperLED нет в trusted_clients в moonraker.conf

label.en: From both ends to the middle

hint.de: Wie sich der Balken beim Vorheizen und Drucken füllt
hint.en: How the bar fills while preheating and printing
hint.ru: Как заполняется полоса при нагреве и печати

label.en: Preheating when this far below target (°C)

hint.de: Als Vorheizen gilt, wenn eine Düse oder das Bett mehr als so viele Grad unter ihrer Solltemperatur liegt
hint.en: Counts as preheating when the nozzle or bed is more than this many degrees below its target
hint.ru: Считается нагревом, если сопло или стол ниже заданной температуры больше, чем на это число градусов

hint.de: Dimmt nur die Farben dieses Plugins; die Helligkeit des Segments gilt zusätzlich. Wirkt nur mit dem Skript
hint.en: Dims only this plugin's colours; the segment's brightness applies on top. Only works with the script
hint.ru: Затемняет только цвета плагина; яркость сегмента действует поверх. Работает только со скриптом

hint.de: Aus ist ruhiger: Das Atmen schickt öfter Bilder an die LEDs, und manche Streifen flackern dann
hint.en: Off is calmer: breathing sends more pictures to the LEDs, and some strips flicker then
hint.ru: Выкл. спокойнее: дыхание чаще шлёт кадры на светодиоды, и некоторые ленты мерцают

hint.de: Schwarz schaltet das Segment im Leerlauf dunkel
hint.en: Black darkens the segment while idle

hint.de: Zeigt nach einem Druck die Fertig-Farbe, bis der Drucker in den Leerlauf geht (idle_timeout in Klipper)
hint.en: Shows the finished colour after a print until the printer goes idle (idle_timeout in Klipper)
hint.ru: После печати показывает цвет «готово», пока принтер не перейдёт в простой (idle_timeout в Klipper)

hint.de: Gilt, wenn der Drucker nicht antwortet (ausgeschaltet oder Moonraker nicht erreichbar). Schwarz = aus
hint.en: Applies when the printer does not answer (switched off or Moonraker unreachable). Black = off
hint.ru: Действует, когда принтер не отвечает (выключен или Moonraker недоступен). Чёрный = выкл.

rules.when: (state == 'standby' or (state == 'printing' and duration < 2)) and (g0 > heat_margin or g1 > heat_margin or g2 > heat_margin or g3 > heat_margin or bed_gap > heat_margin)

script:
-- HyperLED plugin "Klipper Status Display": draws the state of a Klipper 3D printer on the segment.
--
-- Copyright (c) 2026 Dennis Guse
-- Licensed under the PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0 (see the LICENSE file of this repository).

















local floor, ceil, min, max = math.floor, math.ceil, math.min, math.max




local level = 1

local function rgb(c)
return floor(((c // 65536) % 256) * level), floor(((c // 256) % 256) * level), floor((c % 256) * level)
end

local function scaled(c, k)
local r, g, b = rgb(c)
return floor(r * k), floor(g * k), floor(b * k)
end


local function pulse(t)
local p = (t % 2000) / 1000
if p > 1 then p = 2 - p end
return p
end


local function heaterShare(temp, target)
if temp == nil or target == nil or target <= 0 then return nil end
local s = temp / target
if s < 0 then s = 0 elseif s > 1 then s = 1 end
return s
end




local TEMPS = { "e0", "e1", "e2", "e3", "bed" }
local GAPS = { "g0", "g1", "g2", "g3", "bed_gap" }

local mode, share = "idle", 0
local shareMode = nil






local function keep(value)
if mode == shareMode and value < share and share - value < 0.3 then
if share - value >= 0.01 then log("bar would fall from " .. floor(share * 100) .. " to " .. floor(value * 100) .. " %") end
return
end
share = value
shareMode = mode
end



local headBreath = false





local function rate(m)
if m == "heating" or m == "paused" or m == "error" then return 10 end
if m == "printing" and headBreath then return 5 end
return 2
end
fps = rate(mode)


function update()
level = max(5, min(100, settings.brightness or 100)) / 100
headBreath = settings.head_pulse == true
local state = v.state
local margin = settings.heat_margin or 10


local heating, lowest = false, nil
for i = 1, #TEMPS do
local temp, gap = v[TEMPS[i]], v[GAPS[i]]
if gap ~= nil and gap > margin then heating = true end
if temp ~= nil and gap ~= nil then
local s = heaterShare(temp, temp + gap)
if s ~= nil and (lowest == nil or s < lowest) then lowest = s end
end
end
if state == "error" then
mode = "error"
elseif state == "paused" then
mode = "paused"
elseif state == "complete" and settings.show_done and v.idle ~= "Idle" then
mode = "done"
elseif heating and (state == "standby" or (state == "printing" and (v.duration or 0) < 2)) then

mode = "heating"
keep(lowest or 0)
elseif state == "printing" then
mode = "printing"
local value = (v.progress or 0) / 100
if value < 0 then value = 0 elseif value > 1 then value = 1 end
keep(value)
else
mode = "idle"
end
fps = rate(mode)
end


local function span(x, a, b)
local lo = max(a, x)
local hi = min(b, x + 1)
if hi > lo then return hi - lo end
return 0
end




local function cover(i, len, dir, n)
if dir == "rtl" then return span(i, n - len, n) end
if dir == "both" then return min(1, span(i, 0, len / 2) + span(i, n - len / 2, n)) end
if dir == "center" then return span(i, (n - len) / 2, (n + len) / 2) end
return span(i, 0, len)
end


local function heads(len, dir, n)
if len >= n then return -1, -1 end
if dir == "rtl" then return floor(n - len), -1 end
if dir == "both" then return ceil(len / 2) - 1, floor(n - len / 2) end
if dir == "center" then return floor((n - len) / 2), ceil((n + len) / 2) - 1 end
return ceil(len) - 1, -1
end




local function bar(c, t, breathing, headPulse)
local k = breathing and (0.35 + 0.65 * pulse(t)) or 1
local kh = headPulse and (0.3 + 0.7 * pulse(t)) or 1
local dir = settings.direction or "ltr"
local layout = settings._layout or "grid"
if layout == "grid" then

local len = max(1, share * W)
local h1, h2 = heads(len, dir, W)
for x = 0, W - 1 do
local f = cover(x, len, dir, W)
local r, g, b = scaled(c, k * f * ((x == h1 or x == h2) and kh or 1))
for y = 0, H - 1 do px(x, y, r, g, b) end
end
else


local n = settings._leds or 0
if n < 1 or n > W * H then n = W * H end
local first = settings._first or 0
local len = max(1, share * n)
local snake = layout == "snake"
local h1, h2 = heads(len, dir, n)
for j = 0, n - 1 do
local f = cover(j, len, dir, n)
local i = first + j
local row = i // W
local x = i % W
if snake and row % 2 == 1 then x = W - 1 - x end
local r, g, b = scaled(c, k * f * ((j == h1 or j == h2) and kh or 1))
px(x, row, r, g, b)
end
end
end

function frame(t)
if mode == "error" then
if (t // 250) % 2 == 0 then fill(rgb(settings.c_error or 0xFF0000)) else clear() end
elseif mode == "paused" then
fill(scaled(settings.c_pause or 0xFFC800, 0.15 + 0.85 * pulse(t)))
elseif mode == "done" then
fill(rgb(settings.c_done or 0x00C8FF))
elseif mode == "heating" then
bar(settings.c_heat or 0xFF7A00, t, true)
elseif mode == "printing" then
bar(settings.c_print or 0x00D060, t, false, headBreath)
else
fill(rgb(settings.c_idle or 0x001A33))
end
end
